original.target_description: Study 1a: independent-samples t-test of averaged perceived leader power, comparing large versus small vertical difference in the organization chart among Erasmus University economics and business administration students.

es.location: Manuscript p. 11, Study 1a, Results (journal locator p. 33; supplied manuscript has different pagination).
